name: Nagasare Kanojo to Ousama Game
original_name: 流され彼女と王様ゲーム
source:
She is a member of the girl group whose background is unknown.
Has a reason to cheer up the drinking party.
Tends to be seen as an easy girl because of 
her risque fashion but in fact she is the shyest in the group.
Potentially masochist.
